Option Card (OptionCard, was ExportCard)

Plan — coverage re-check 21 OctUpgrade of ExportCard · built 20 Oct, reworked 21 Oct

A bordered card for starting one of a few actions (export route, entry action) or picking one option (document format, division) with a radio or checkbox. This re-check compares the 11 Replace-in-modules cards with their module screens, proposes the missing configurations and rescans all six module files. Nothing was written to Figma.

4. Gaps that properties cannot reproduce

IdGap
G1Vertical height jump
In vertical layout, default and hover are 164 px high, selected and disabled 156 px (the Text frame is 80 px vs 72 px). In a BOM Export row the selected card will be 8 px shorter than its neighbours. Fix in the component (same Text frame height in all states), not in Replace.
G2Tag position is fixed
The tag sits on its own line between title and description. The 20 Oct plan said "in the title row". Cheat Sheet uses the tag as the leading visual (left of the title); SPEC 02 shows it after the description. No property controls the position.
G3Tag style
The nested tag is Tag__Colorful blue (light). Cheat Sheet uses Tag__Checkable checked (solid primary, white text). SPEC 02 draws its own tag with a raw #e6f4ff fill, which matches Tag__Colorful blue.
G4Coming-soon teaser look
No muted or info look exists. The module teaser is a flat colorFillQuaternary panel without border or shadow, with a normal dark title and a right-aligned Link atom. OptionCard disabled greys the title and description, keeps the shadow, and its link is a plain text line on the left.
G5Primitive icon colour
BOM Hub Upload and the local set use the primitive Lime/lime-7. The Replace cards bind the same primitive; it does not switch in dark mode. No semantic token fits (BOM 4.1 uses colorSuccessHover for the Excel icon).
G6Disabled icon not dimmed
In every disabled variant the icon keeps its full colour (green in the component screenshot), while the text turns to colorTextDisabled.
G7Selected and border colours differ from the modules
BOM pressed = 2 px colorPrimary, no tint. SPEC 05 selected fill = colorFillQuaternary. SPEC unselected border = colorBorder. OptionCard uses 1 px colorPrimary + colorPrimaryBg for selected and colorBorderSecondary at rest. Harmonized on 20 Oct; listed so the module teams know what changes.
G8Live BOM instances after publish
16 remote instances in BOM 4.1–4.4 still use the old axes (control = none, state = default or pressed). After publishing, swap the 4 pressed ones to selected, and check that the 12 default ones resolve to type = action, state = default.
G9Link width in horizontal variants
The hidden Link text keeps a fixed 185 px width in horizontal variants (the text column is 263–291 px). A longer link wraps earlier than the description. Check before more links are used.

Open questions

  1. Match module widths on the Replace cards?

    Recommended: yes (#5–#11). The Replace section gets wider (SPEC cards 856 px), and SPEC 02 at 203 px checks the narrow case.

  2. Tag position (G2): keep it on its own line under the title, or move it into the title row as the 20 Oct plan said?

    Recommended: keep it under the title. It fits the 203 px division card; a title-row tag would wrap there.

  3. Coming-soon teaser (G4): accept the disabled look?

    Recommended: accept for now and note the difference; add a muted look only if a second module needs one.

  4. Hub harmonization sign-off (title 20 → 16 px, 2 px light-blue border → shadow).

    Still open from 20 Oct. Needed before BOM swaps the local "Shared / Export Format Card" for OptionCard.

  5. Retarget links to the exact card nodes?

    Recommended: yes where the card is a normal frame or instance (#1–#9). #11 stays on the screen because of the modal slot.

  6. Fix the vertical height jump (G1) in the component before publishing?

    Recommended: yes. It affects the BOM Export rows after the pressed → selected swap.

Gaps, not done, and decisions needed

Needs the user's decision

  • BOM 1.1, 1.6, Cheat Sheet and the local component set (needs design sign-off). Harmonizing the Hub cards means title 20 px to 16 px and a 2 px blue border to a shadow card. The Replace cards are built; the change should be approved before the BOM file adopts them.
  • Rename ExportCard to Option Card. Not done (undecided). The component set description says so.
  • BOM 4.1 to 4.4. Manual follow-up in the BOM file: switch the selected card from pressed to selected.

Gaps and notes

  • Icon colour of the component default. The default icon uses Color/Preset/Lime/colorLimeText (lime-7 in light, lime-6 in dark). It is a preset colour, not a semantic token (BOM 4.1 uses colorSuccessHover for the same icon). Not changed, so existing instances stay as they are; a decision is needed if you want a semantic default.
  • Icon colour bound to a primitive. BOM Hub Upload and the local set use the primitive Lime/lime-7 in the module. The Replace cards bind the same primitive. It matches colorLimeText in light mode but does not switch in dark mode.
  • Loading. In state=loading the show icon and ↳ 🎰 icon properties exist but do not change the spinner.
  • Disabled link. The link line is not dimmed in disabled variants (it keeps the link colour).
  • Tag colour. The nested Tag is Tag__Colorful blue. The BOM Cheat Sheet uses Tag__Checkable; the colour differs slightly.
  • Pre-existing, now fixed. The focus, disabled and loading variants had no text property link for title and description; they are now linked like the others.
  • Colour of existing instances. The description colour moves from colorTextDescription (45 %) to colorTextSecondary (65 %). Known intentional change, approved. The 88 % overrides on BOM 4.1 are no longer needed.
  • Variant matrix. Not built in full (2 x 3 x 7 = 42). Built 25: vertical + none x 7 states; horizontal + none / radio / checkbox x default, hover, pressed, focus, selected, disabled. Not built: loading in horizontal layouts, and radio or checkbox in vertical layout.
  • No new tokens. No variable, style or token was created.
  • Follow-up (20 Oct 2026). Added pressed and focus for horizontal none, radio and checkbox (6 variants: 2004:211, 2004:220, 2004:229, 2004:242, 2004:255, 2004:267). Hover already existed for all three. Pressed and focus use a 2 px colorPrimary border like the vertical ones; radio and checkbox cards keep colorBgContainer and no shadow, the nested control stays in its default state. The Components section grew to 440 x 4012 and Replace in modules moved down to y 4132.
  • Placement (page rule). FeatureCard (component set 1555:370) sits loose on the canvas next to the Components section, not inside a Components section. Reported only, not moved.

Publish

The Hydra library has to be published before the changes reach the module files.

Decision

Upgrade ExportCard on ❖ Cards (node 826:1181). Every new property defaults to today's behaviour. Related: Choice List Row (long compact lists) and FeatureCard (promotional teaser) stay separate. Cards with a full-width button inside (SPEC "ConnectED Actions") are not Option Cards.
